record.question: Hypochondriasis is characterized by:
options: A sudden loss of sensory or motor function without a physical cause
An excessive and persistent belief that one has a serious illness, despite medical reassurance
Repeated complaints of pain that have no identifiable medical cause
A preoccupation with an imagined or slight defect in appearance
record.explanation: Answer B: An excessive and persistent belief that one has a serious illness, despite medical reassurance. The former term hypochondriasis is now generally represented by illness anxiety disorder: persistent preoccupation with having/acquiring serious illness despite absent or mild symptoms and reassurance. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK554399/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
